decisions: Cover all three requested surfaces: public docs/help, README and agent reference, and homepage/SEO marketing.
Keep the feature documentation-only and dependent on F743's final merged registry contract.
Update exhaustive rosters and affected capability claims, but do not mechanically add Copilot to illustrative examples.
Retain valid screenshots and GIFs; limit visual work to source copy, metadata, and alt text.
Position Copilot as one entitlement routing among model families, not as multiple independent vendor quota pools.
Recommend Auto while documenting entitlement-dependent named model choices and absent v1 telemetry/resume support.
constraints: Do not alter F743 implementation behavior or registry configuration.
Use F743's merged cp registry and generated agent guide as the source of truth.
Do not hand-edit generated Pagefind output.
Keep public claims accurate for plan and organization-policy differences.
nonGoals: No Copilot telemetry, quota polling, resume support, or benchmark work.
No screenshot, GIF, or social-card regeneration.
No broad rewrite of scenario-specific tutorials.
implementationNotes: Audit README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, templates/help.txt, package.json, site/content, site/app, and site/public/home.html.
Run npm run docs:check, npm run build --prefix site, node scripts/check-template-leaks.js, and git diff --check.
Review desktop and 390px layouts only if changed copy materially affects wrapping.
